_readme: What's Good Local weekly deals feed for the Big Island. Written by the weekly scheduled task; see CLAUDE.md.

deals.name: Jackie Rey's Ohana Grill Hilo
deals.deal: $6.50 and $7.50 happy hour pupus, daily 3-5 PM
deals.details: Happy hour pupu picks are $6.50 (such as truffle fries and edamame) and $7.50 (such as clam chowder and kalua pork quesadilla); $7.50 classic cocktails, $9 wines and $6.50 drafts.

deals.name: Ka Lihikai (Grand Naniloa Hotel)
deals.deal: Poke tacos $6 each or 2 for $10 at happy hour, daily 3-5 PM
deals.details: Happy hour small plates include poke tacos at $6 each or 2 for $10, lengua street tacos $6 and fried Spam musubi $6.

deals.name: Kona Brewing Kona Pub
deals.deal: 15% off food for kama'aina, military and first responders
deals.details: Community Appreciation all week: 15% off the food menu for kama'aina, military and first responders, dine-in only, not on holidays. Industry Thursday gives hospitality workers 20% off food with proof of employment.

deals.name: The Hidden Nene
deals.deal: Early bird charcuterie special, 12-2 PM
deals.details: The early bird specials run 12 to 2 PM with a build-your-own charcuterie board offer, per the posted menu. Ages 21 and over only.

deals.name: The Temple Kitchen + Bar
deals.deal: Taco and margarita specials Tuesdays 5-9 PM
deals.details: Taco and margarita specials every Tuesday from 5 to 9 PM.

deals.name: Huggo's
deals.deal: Liquid Happy Hour daily 4-5 PM
deals.details: Liquid Happy Hour runs every day from 4 to 5 PM; the oceanfront hBAR opens at 4 PM daily.

deals.name: Huggo's On The Rocks
deals.deal: Happy hour daily 3-5 PM with cocktails and pupus
deals.details: Happy hour runs from 3 to 5 PM daily with a selection of cocktails and pupus.

deals.name: Island Lava Java
deals.deal: Happy hour daily 3:30-5:30 PM; Thirsty Thursday cocktails at happy hour pricing all day
deals.details: The specials calendar lists happy hour daily from 3:30 to 5:30 PM and Thirsty Thursday cocktails at happy hour pricing from 7 AM to 8:30 PM.

deals.name: Ka Lihikai (Grand Naniloa Hotel)
deals.deal: $5 draft beer, wine and well cocktails, daily 3-5 PM
deals.details: Happy hour daily 3 to 5 PM: 16 oz draft beer, glass of wine and well cocktails $5, Ka Lihikai Tai $10. Small plates include poke tacos at $6 each or 2 for $10.

deals.name: Kai Eats + Drinks
deals.deal: $8 cocktails, $5 well drinks, $6 wine, $2 off taps, daily 3:30-5:30 PM
deals.details: Happy hour daily 3:30 to 5:30 PM at bar seating only; the happy hour menu also lists bar bites and Naples-style pizzas from $12.

deals.name: Lava Lava Beach Club
deals.deal: Happy hour daily 2-4 PM
deals.details: The restaurant lists happy hour daily from 2 to 4 PM on Anaeho'omalu Bay at Waikoloa Beach Resort.

deals.name: Papa Kona Restaurant & Bar
deals.deal: Happy hour Mon-Fri 1-5 PM, Sat-Sun 3-5 PM
deals.details: Happy hour runs Monday to Friday 1 to 5 PM and Saturday and Sunday 3 to 5 PM.

deals.name: The Hidden Nene
deals.deal: Pau hana happy hour 6-8 PM
deals.details: The speakeasy lists happy hours at 12 to 2 PM and 6 to 8 PM. Ages 21 and over only, no reservations.

deals.name: The Temple Kitchen + Bar
deals.deal: Happy hour Mon-Fri 3-5 PM; weekend brunch happy hour 9 AM-3 PM
deals.details: Happy hour Monday to Friday 3 to 5 PM, plus a weekend brunch happy hour from 9 AM to 3 PM.

deals.name: Tommy Bahama Restaurant & Bar Mauna Lani
deals.deal: Happy hour daily 3-5 PM
deals.details: Happy hour runs daily from 3 to 5 PM at The Shops at Mauna Lani.
deals.location: The Shops at Mauna Lani · 68-1330 Mauna Lani Dr #102

deals.name: Body Glove Hawaii
deals.deal: Kama'aina Holo Holo Pass: 15% to 42% off cruises
deals.details: Free pass for Hawaii residents with a Hawaii State ID; the discount ranges from 15% to 42% depending on the cruise and applies when booking online with the membership ID.

deals.name: Captain Zodiac
deals.deal: 20% off snorkel tours when booked before Dec 15
deals.details: The operator's Cyber Monday offer takes 20% off snorkel tours booked before December 15.

deals.name: Fair Wind Cruises
deals.deal: Kama'aina Club: 15% off morning and afternoon snorkel trips
deals.details: Free club for Hawaii residents (driver's license or state ID required); 15% off morning and afternoon snorkel trips on the Fair Wind II and Hula Kai, including the evening manta trip. Members also get one free adult pass with every 10 fares at club rates.
deals.location: Kealakekua Bay and Keauhou Bay departures

deals.name: Jack's Diving Locker
deals.deal: Save 10% when you dive 3 or more days
deals.details: Package pricing for divers takes 10% off when diving three or more days.

deals.name: Kohala Zipline
deals.deal: Kama'aina Canopy Club: 20% off select zipline adventures
deals.details: Free club for Hawaii residents with a valid Hawaii driver's license or state ID; book online with the membership ID to receive the discount.

deals.name: Kona Honu Divers
deals.deal: Dive packages: 10% off 3 trips, 15% off 5, 20% off 10
deals.details: Package discounts apply to each charter booked for the same diver; free nitrox for Enriched Air divers. Boats leave Honokohau Harbor.

deals.name: Sea Quest Hawaii
deals.deal: $10 off three snorkel tours with code ADVENTURE10
deals.details: Code ADVENTURE10 at checkout takes $10 off the Deluxe Morning Adventure, Premium Morning Snorkel or Expedition South Kona.
